question: Can we name the leaking allocator, choose a safe fleet limit and estimate the failure probability from this sample?

criteria.instruction: The selected charges explain one stipulated limit breach, not a leak mechanism or population distribution. There is no retained-allocation/time series, representative peak/concurrency dataset or failure denominator. A capacity change requires separate evidence and approval.
Use accounting/worker observations and limits to identify the missing leak, high-water and fleet evidence.
Decline a named leak, certified fleet memory limit and numeric failure probability. Do not equate a low heap with absence of group pressure.
